name: Misakura Aika
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c38477]Aoi's[/url] childhood friend, and the older of the Misakura twins. Very different from her sister [url=https://vndb.org/c24939]Yuuka[/url], she's a cheeky and tsun-tsun type of girl.

She seems to have a thing for Aoi, but her pride and jealousy issues keep her from being honest. Because of this, her actions and behavior towards him don't always match.

She bullied Aoi a lot when they were kids, will she change her ways now?
